## SuperSubtitler 0.3.5 — one button updates everything

Download both files into one folder: `SuperSubtitlerGUI.exe` (the window) and `SuperSubtitler.exe` (the engine).

### 🔄 Update window and SuperSubtitler at once
- **About → "Update window and SuperSubtitler"** now brings *both* files to the newest release — no more fetching the window from GitHub by hand.
- Every download is checked against the release's checksums before it replaces anything; SuperSubtitler.exe is also test-started first and the old one kept as a backup.
- The window replaces itself and restarts on its own; after the restart it says which version it is now.
- On start the window quietly looks whether a newer release exists and tells you — nothing is downloaded without your click.

**This one time** you still need to download `SuperSubtitlerGUI.exe` 0.3.5 yourself (the older window only knew how to update SuperSubtitler.exe). From then on, one click is enough.

The exes are not code-signed; Windows SmartScreen may warn — "More info" → "Run anyway". Built by GitHub Actions.
